name: torob-mcp
description: MCP server for Torob (Iran's price-comparison engine): search, compare and price-check across shops. Read-only, no API key.
long_description:
Torob is Iran's price-comparison engine. This bundle runs the torob-mcp server locally over stdio, so an agent can search Torob, read every seller's offer on a product, compare prices across shops, check a product's own price history, look up a seller's Torob profile, find products from a picture link, walk the category tree and list provinces and cities - all in Toman.

All fourteen tools are read-only and need no API key, no account and no login. This server never signs in to Torob, never solves or evades a bot challenge and never contacts a shop; a challenge is reported as a clear, actionable error instead of being retried into a longer block, which is exactly how the hosted service behaves.

The bundle is the local half of torob-mcp. The hosted Cloudflare Workers endpoint at https://torob-mcp.mmdju3.workers.dev/mcp is unchanged and still available for clients that prefer a remote URL. A self-hosted run like this one has no rate limit of its own; the hosted copy answers at most 20 `/mcp` calls a minute per client IP.

Prices and stock move constantly, and an answer may be served from what this server fetched up to half an hour ago - always confirm on torob.com before buying. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Torob.

tools.name: torob_suggest
tools.description: Turn vague or colloquial wording into the search terms Torob itself suggests.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Torob and get compact product cards: the cheapest offer in Toman, the shop behind it, image, badges, product URL, and the filter groups this search really accepts.

tools.name: product_details
tools.description: One product plus every seller offer, cheapest first, with shop scores, vote counts, postage and guarantee - plus the shops selling it in person.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Torob's own monthly price chart for one product, its lowest and highest charted prices, and - with include_changes - the newest moves across its shops.

tools.name: similar_products
tools.description: Products Torob considers comparable to one this server has already returned, cheapest first, as cards.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Put 2-5 products side by side: cheapest price, number of sellers, the price spread between shops and the best rated seller.

tools.name: find_best_value
tools.description: Search for the user's item and rank what is actually buyable under a budget in Toman, out-of-stock rows excluded.

tools.name: shop_profile
tools.description: One shop as Torob profiles it: trust seal, score and vote count, Torob's own notes, city, address, payment and delivery options - and with include_products its own catalogue.

tools.name: find_shops
tools.description: Search Torob's shop directory - businesses, not products - by name or by city, every row carrying the id shop_profile needs.

tools.name: search_by_image
tools.description: Match products to a public image URL; when Torob recognises the picture as one specific product, matched_product names it.

tools.name: torob_trends
tools.description: What Torob's shoppers are searching right now, each with one sample product.

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: Walk Torob's category tree one level at a time, each category carrying its product count.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List Torob's provinces, or the cities of one province, with the ids search_products accepts.

tools.name: special_offers
tools.description: The deals Torob is featuring right now - merchandising, not a product's seller list.
